## Invocation

Workflows are invoked via the AI agent's slash command in Claude Code / Cursor
(e.g., `/bmad-bam-<skill-name>`) or natural-language activation. There is no
`bmad run X` CLI command (see audit check (h) in tests/audit-marketplace.sh).
